A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same VisionTrim work. Their complete main texts, equations, tables, figures, and appendices support reliable comparison, including matching content across appendix relabeling and layout changes.

before.justification: v1 reports original benchmark evaluations, efficiency measurements, ablations, and qualitative analyses in Section 4 and the appendices, including Tables 1–25.

after.justification: v3 retains these original benchmark results, efficiency measurements, ablations, and qualitative analyses in Section 4 and the appendices.

M1.justification: Sections 3.1–3.3 retain the same DVTS scoring, TGVC text-guided clustering and aggregation, and two-stage pruning procedure. The added attribution for LTAM does not change its algorithm.

E1.justification: The evaluated coverage is unchanged, including image/video question answering, multi-image tasks, captioning, referring-object classification, retrieval, and OCR. The additional experiments in v1 Appendix C are retained in v3 Appendix D.

E2.justification: Corresponding comparisons retain their comparator sets, including SparseVLM, VisionZip, PDrop, and VScan in Table 1; Turbo in Tables 17 and 19; and direct text guidance and random pruning in Tables 23–24. The newly cited works are not added experimental baselines.

E3.justification: Token budgets, model configurations, metrics, video sampling, layer-placement settings, and fine-tuning data settings match across versions. Tables 11–12, 15, and 26 retain the same configurations, and no new evaluation protocol is introduced.

E4.justification: The component and ensemble ablations, extreme-compression analyses, layer-selection tests, inter-frame compression comparison, non-CLIP evaluation, and case studies already appear in v1 and are retained in v3. Appendix relocation does not introduce new analyses.

E5.justification: Both versions use the same point-estimate reporting. Neither reports experimental run counts, random seeds, confidence intervals, error bars, or significance tests.

E6.justification: Matched numerical results, plotted findings, and qualitative examples are unchanged. For example, Table 1 retains 98.8% relative average performance at 64 tokens, and Table 13 retains 82.8% relative performance for training-free compression to one token.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions and Equations (1)–(15), including the computational-cost derivations in v1 Appendix B and v3 Appendix C, are unchanged. Adding a comma after Equation (5) has no mathematical effect.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, contribution statements, and conclusion retain the same claims about unified training-free compression, the DVTS/TGVC modules, and performance-efficiency advantages. No main contribution is added, removed, or substantively redefined.

C2.justification: Interpretations concerning cross-modal alignment, poor textual prompts, knowledge-boundary drift, and performance-efficiency trade-offs remain unchanged. Section 5 retains the residual-accuracy-loss limitation, and the appendix retains its deployment and robustness cautions.

D1.justification: Hardware disclosures, hyperparameters, token allocations, fine-tuning data, the code link, and resource-access information in Table 27 are unchanged. The new Appendix B concerns GPT-4-assisted manuscript editing and adds no experimental implementation details.

R1.justification: Section 3.1 newly identifies Ru et al. (2022), Learning affinity from attention, and Li et al. (2023b), Label-efficient segmentation via affinity propagation, as inspirations for LTAM. Both references are added to the bibliography; the broader research positioning remains unchanged.

P1.justification: v3 adds an LLM-use disclosure as Appendix B and funding acknowledgements, updates affiliations and contribution notes, and changes the publication header. Subsequent appendices are relabeled and the LTAM introduction is locally rewritten; the research narrative is otherwise retained.

P2.justification: The same 15 figures and 27 tables retain their contents and designs. Layout changes include references starting on page 10, Tables 23–25 moving from page 21 to page 22, and Figure 8 moving from page 22 to page 23.

improvement.justification: v3 modestly improves scholarly attribution by explicitly identifying LTAM's methodological inspirations and improves transparency through the manuscript-editing disclosure in Appendix B. These are limited reporting gains; the methods, empirical evidence, limitations, and experimental reproducibility information remain unchanged.
